title: DisplayServer.get_screen_count() on MacOS returns 1 when it should be 2 - broke in v4.5.dev4
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in Godot Engine v4.5.dev4.mono.official.209a446e3 and later including Godot Engine v4.5.beta6.mono.official.d5ad0556a Not reproducible in Godot Engine v4.5.dev3.mono.official.28089c40c and below including Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.mono.official.49a5bc7b6 ### System information Godot v4.5.beta1.mono - macOS Sequoia (15.5.0) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 Pro (Apple7) - Apple M1 Pro (8 threads) - 16.00 GiB memory ### Issue description Print out value of DisplayServer.get_screen_count() ```gdscript extends Node2D func _ready(): var count = DisplayServer.get_screen_count() print("screen count:", count) ``` Should be 2, be is 1. Godot Engine v4.5.beta6.mono.official.d5ad0556a - https://godotengine.org Metal 3.2 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Apple - Apple M1 Pro (Apple7) screen count:1 --- Debugging process stopped --- Godot Engine v4.5.beta1.mono.official.46c495ca2 - https://godotengine.org Metal 3.2 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Apple - Apple M1 Pro (Apple7) screen count:1 --- Debugging process stopped --- Godot Engine v4.5.dev4.mono.official.209a446e3 - https://godotengine.org Metal 3.2 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Apple - Apple M1 Pro (Apple7) screen count:1 --- Debugging process stopped --- Godot Engine v4.5.dev3.mono.official.28089c40c - https://godotengine.org Metal 3.2 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Apple - Apple M1 Pro (Apple7) screen count:2 --- Debugging process stopped --- Godot Engine v4.5.dev2.mono.official.af2c71397 - https://godotengine.org Metal 3.2 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Apple - Apple M1 Pro (Apple7) screen count:2 --- Debugging process stopped --- Godot Engine v4.5.dev1.mono.official.97241ffea - https://godotengine.org Metal 3.2 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Apple - Apple M1 Pro (Apple7) screen count:2 --- Debugging process stopped --- Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.mono.official.49a5bc7b6 - https://godotengine.org Metal 3.2 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Apple - Apple M1 Pro (Apple7) screen count:2 --- Debugging process stopped --- ### Steps to reproduce Run the scene, it prints out the screen count to the output window. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [screencountbroken.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21946109/screencountbroken.zip)
